snippet.title: SNOW OP 1080p 60 fps
snippet.description:
https://vndb.org/v893
https://www.ryuugames.com/eng-snow-plus-edition/

great visual novel, recently got an english translation. for some reason youtube doesnt let videos below 1280x720 get 60 fps so the quality is now 1440x1080 instead of native 800x600.
